From ebbbc4bfad4cb355d17c671223d0814ee3ef4eda Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Paulo Alcantara <pc@manguebit.org>
Date: Thu, 5 Feb 2026 13:19:52 -0300
Subject: [PATCH] smb: client: fix potential UAF and double free in
 smb2_open_file()

Zero out @err_iov and @err_buftype before retrying SMB2_open() to
prevent an UAF bug if @data != NULL, otherwise a double free.

Fixes: e3a43633023e ("smb/client: fix memory leak in smb2_open_file()")
Reported-by: David Howells <dhowells@redhat.com>
Closes: https://lore.kernel.org/r/2892312.1770306653@warthog.procyon.org.uk
Signed-off-by: Paulo Alcantara (Red Hat) <pc@manguebit.org>
Reviewed-by: David Howells <dhowells@redhat.com>
Reviewed-by: ChenXiaoSong <chenxiaosong@kylinos.cn>
Cc: linux-cifs@vger.kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Steve French <stfrench@microsoft.com>

diff --git a/fs/smb/client/smb2file.c b/fs/smb/client/smb2file.c
index 2dd08388ea87..1f7f284a7844 100644
--- a/fs/smb/client/smb2file.c
+++ b/fs/smb/client/smb2file.c
@@ -179,6 +179,8 @@ int smb2_open_file(const unsigned int xid, struct cifs_open_parms *oparms,
 		       &err_buftype);
 	if (rc == -EACCES && retry_without_read_attributes) {
 		free_rsp_buf(err_buftype, err_iov.iov_base);
+		memset(&err_iov, 0, sizeof(err_iov));
+		err_buftype = CIFS_NO_BUFFER;
 		oparms->desired_access &= ~FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES;
 		rc = SMB2_open(xid, oparms, smb2_path, &smb2_oplock, smb2_data, NULL, &err_iov,
 			       &err_buftype);
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary of Modifications

### Files Modified

**`fs/smb/client/smb2file.c`**  
- In function `smb2_open_file()`, within the error handling for `-EACCES` that triggers a retry without `FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES`:
  - Added `memset(&err_iov, 0, sizeof(err_iov));` to zero out the `err_iov` structure.
  - Added `err_buftype = CIFS_NO_BUFFER;` to reset the buffer type to a safe initial state.

These two lines are inserted after the existing `free_rsp_buf(err_buftype, err_iov.iov_base);` call and before the retry call to `SMB2_open()`.

### Relationship Between Modifications

The change is confined to a single file and a single code path. The two added statements are directly related: after freeing the previously allocated response buffer, both `err_iov` (which contained the pointer) and `err_buftype` (which tracked the buffer type) must be cleared. This prevents:
- **Use-after-free (UAF)**: Zeroing `err_iov` ensures that if `@data` is non-NULL and later functions inspect `err_iov`, they do not dereference a freed pointer.
- **Double free**: Resetting `err_buftype` to `CIFS_NO_BUFFER` ensures that any subsequent cleanup (e.g., in error paths of the retried `SMB2_open()`) will not attempt to free the already-freed buffer.

The modification is a minimal, targeted fix that secures the retry logic introduced by an earlier commit (e3a43633023e).
